part.kingInCenter.title: King in the center
part.kingInCenter.summary: With the enemy king still in the center and unable to castle, open lines toward it and gain time with every check; with the center closed, the sacrifice opens no way.
ex.kc.qxUs2: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.kc.qxUs2.hint: The pawn on f7 is gone, and the black king is still on e8. Look for a check that sets up a fork by the knight on g5.
ex.kc.qxUs2.solution: 15.Qg6+! The queen gives check along the open diagonal to the king on e8. After 15...Kd8, 16.Nf7+! is a fork: check to the king and an attack on the rook on h8. After 16...Kc8, 17.Nxh8 captures the rook.
ex.kc.W7qqD: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.kc.W7qqD.hint: Draw the king to a square where the knight on g5 gives check and attacks the queen on c7 at the same time.
ex.kc.W7qqD.solution: 21.Qxf8+! The queen gives itself up to draw the king to f8. After 21...Kxf8, 22.Nxe6+! is a fork: check to the king and an attack on the queen on c7. After 22...Ke7, 23.Nxc7, and White comes out ahead in material.
ex.kc.ryVxJ: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.kc.ryVxJ.hint: The white king is still on e1, and your queen's diagonal is open. Start with the checks.
ex.kc.ryVxJ.solution: 21...Qc3+! The queen gives check along the open diagonal to the king on e1. After 22.Ke2, 22...Qd2+! and, after 23.Kf1, 23...Qxd3+ captures the undefended bishop with check.
ex.kc.iY3nG: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.kc.iY3nG.hint: The white king is still on e1, and the d-file is open for your rook. Start with the capture with check.
ex.kc.iY3nG.solution: 16...Bxc3+! The bishop captures the knight with check. After 17.bxc3, 17...Qxc3+! gives check and attacks the rook on a1. After 18.Kf2, 18...Rd2! The rook comes in along the open d-file and attacks the queen on e2, pinned to the king on f2; if the queen takes the rook, the queen on c3 recaptures.
ex.kc.2We0G: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.kc.2We0G.hint: The knight on f6 is the only black piece defending h5, and the black king is still on e8.
ex.kc.2We0G.solution: 14.Nxf6+! The knight captures the knight on f6, which defended h5. After 14...Bxf6, 15.Qh5+! gives check along the diagonal to the king on e8, because the pawn on f7 is gone. After 15...g6, 16.fxg6! threatens 17.gxh7+, with a discovered check from the queen, and Black cannot hold everything.
ex.kc.pUbuI: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.kc.pUbuI.hint: The black king is still on e8, and only the pawn on g6 shields it. Count how many of your pieces attack g6 and how many black ones defend it.
ex.kc.pUbuI.solution: 15.Bxg6+! The bishop gives itself up to open the diagonal to the king on e8. After 15...hxg6, 16.Qxg6+! and, after 16...Ke7, 17.Bd6# is mate: the knight on b5 defends the bishop, and the queen on g6 covers the escape squares.
ex.kc.OBrTs: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.kc.OBrTs.hint: The white king is still on e1. Before using the open d-file, draw the white queen to the first rank, where only the king defends it.
ex.kc.OBrTs.solution: 12...Bxf1! The bishop captures the bishop on f1. After 13.Qxf1, 13...Rd1+! The rook gives itself up on the open d-file and deflects the king, which defended the queen on f1. After 14.Kxd1, 14...Qxf1+ captures the queen with check.
ex.kc.OD6gO: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.kc.OD6gO.hint: The black king is on e8, but the central pawns are locked. Before giving up a piece near the king, look for another target.
ex.kc.OD6gO.solution: 11.Nb7! The knight attacks the queen on d8. After 11...Qc7, 12.Nd6+! gives check, protected by the pawn on e5. After 12...Qxd6, 13.exd6, and White wins the queen for a knight. With the center closed, 11.Nxe6? fxe6 opens no way to the king.
ex.kc.AfitM: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.kc.AfitM.hint: The black king is still on e8 and has not castled. Look at the black pieces standing on the same line as the king.
ex.kc.AfitM.solution: 20.Bb5! The bishop pins the queen on d7 to the king on e8, which has not castled yet. After 20...Qxb5, 21.Nc7+! is a fork: check to the king and an attack on the queen on b5. After 21...Ke7, 22.Nxb5 captures the queen.
ex.kc.kc1cy: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.kc.kc1cy.hint: The white king is still on e1 and defends the white queen. Look for a sequence of checks that pulls the king away from that defense.
ex.kc.kc1cy.solution: 12...Qh4+! The queen gives check along the diagonal to the king on e1. After 13.Qf2, 13...Nxc2+! The knight gives check, attacks the rook on a1 and deflects the king, which defended the queen on f2. After 14.Kd2, 14...Qxf2+ captures the queen.
